digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text send cutover + state-based echo suppression + outbound field diff
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must route through new rich-text codecs (AdfCodec for Cloud pointing to markdown_to_adf/adf_to_markdown; WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefined as decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) for DC) while preserving convergence across passes

Echo suppression uses state-based baseline comparison (current Jira value vs last-synced baseline) rather than lossy round-trip equality, with two distinct compares: emit-side compares normalized outbound vs inbound-decoded remote; baseline-side compares local normalized vs decoded baseline wire

Concurrent both-sides body edits remain local-wins (rebar) but must raise outbound-field-conflict alert and record remote value without introducing new conflict resolution mechanism or changing FIELD_CLASSES

A change-gated 8-byte rich_sha counter persists inline in binding entry (not per-pass timestamp) to detect re-emission loops: incremented when field emitted with unchanged rich_sha, reset on wire change or baseline refresh; at threshold RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT=2, execute exactly ONE post-push GET and overlay result to baseline via merge_baseline (sole baseline writer remains _advance_baselines)

Cutover flag (reconciler.rich_text_cutover: off|cloud|dc|both) gates both send paths and defaults OFF; with flag off or marklas extra absent, degraded to plain-text ADF behaviour; no half-converted wire emitted on fallback

DC comment-diff dedup key remains unchanged (identity codec path untouched) so comment-diff convergence unaffected by cutover flag; two other DC send sites (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _issues.py _DESCRIPTION_CODEC) must route through to_wire (render before fit) or ship un-rendered Markdown
